editorial_audit.notes: Final editorial audit (round 4, checkpoint pass-004, 2026-11-23). Checked: (1) all four changed ranges (phys $0C185, $0C19B, $1FB79, $1FDD0) in source and review.json; (2) a spread sample of source read across every bank: header, data banks 0-2 and 9-11 boundary notes, bank 3 banner/spawn code, bank 6 boss tasks and the former-Unknown neighbourhood, bank 7 stage engine/jump table and CpPlayerLoop palette code, bank 8 DropPod tasks, bank 12 level trigger tables, bank 13 Level3BossTask defeat path, bank 14 hit-box/ObjKill code, bank 15 briefing speaker task, NMI and PPU buffer code; (3) mechanical scans over the whole source: raw RAM operands (0), raw RAM addresses in comment prose, raw code targets (0), address-only/auto globals (0), generic @skip/@loop locals (0), stale Unknown wording, 'no caller' claims vs caller counts, review summaries quoting provenance tags or raw addresses. Findings and fixes: about 125 comment lines named RAM by raw address ($0100-$07FF) although symbols exist - prose now renders them with the same bank-aware symbols as the operands (build.py prose(), also review.py summaries); zero-page prose fixed by hand (ActivePower, ShotX/ShotXHi/ShotY/ShotActive, PlayerFacingX, MapScroll*); $E6-$E8 renamed MapScrollLeft/Down/Up (were Unk_* while MapScrollRight's note already named their roles); $057B shown as PasswordDigits in stage code that uses it as the spawn log - aliases SpawnLog (bank 12) / SpawnLogLo (banks 7, 8, 13, ObjKill in 14); $0795 in bank 15 -> BriefingSpeakerIndex; SetPriorityIf070A -> SetPriorityIfInWater; SelectPower and ObjKill comments rewritten (old ones misdescribed operands); .word $0751/$0548 inline sprite pointers -> HudPowerSpriteDef/HudScoreSpriteDef; inline SetSpriteDefInline comments unified as 'sprite definition'; PasswordTable given its own note; review.json summaries regenerated: 373 Data and 149 Code entry summaries and 206 unit summaries changed vs round 3 (inline words now name their helper and target; no phase-1 provenance tags; RAM prose symbolised; the 4 manual-fallback entries carry the disclosure). Residual limitations: the four 1-byte $60 ranges are generic Data, meaning unknown, classified only by a user-directed manual fallback (Manual provenance), not an observed or statically proven data role; their prior code-vs-data ambiguity (lone unreferenced never-fetched $60 after RTS) is unresolved and disclosed in source/review/uncertainties.md. 106 Unk_* RAM symbols keep 'role uncertain' notes; SetPriorityIf0745/_6/0746 and VecSpare*/CallCpStageBank_A0xx keep address-based names (role or bank unknown/variable); 29 flag-only local labels; 941 uncommented branch-entry units are summarised by their parent routine; data banks 0-2/9-11 and many sprite-definition blocks have boundary/format notes only; game identities of objects remain mechanical (uncertainties.md). Phase-1 evidence lines quoted in source keep historical raw addresses by design. The audit cannot measure explanation quality beyond this sample; no whole-source reread was done this round (round-1..3 review credit reused).
